org: Mayo Clinic – Genomic and Bioinformatic Services (GBS) UI style guide
accessNotes: The Google Doc (prepared by the Visual Analytics Group, NCSA, University of Illinois, Sept 7 2022) exported fully as text and HTML; embedded images extracted from the HTML export. IMPORTANT: the document is an application UI style guide for PrimeNG/Ultima-based GBS web apps (foundations, buttons, tags, badges, tabs, inputs, tables, dialogs, paginators). It contains NO chart or data-visualisation guidance (no mention of charts, axes, legends or plots), so all chart-specific fields are null; colour/typography values are the app tokens that a chart theme embedded in these apps would inherit.
summary: A clinical-genomics web-application UI guide built on PrimeNG's Ultima theme: Roboto type, Material-style blue primary #2196F3 with a Mayo-blue (#0057B8) top bar, white cards on a #FAFAFA ground, 87%/60% black text, flat square tags, and a strong 'reduce visual noise' philosophy for very dense data tables. Any charts in these apps should inherit this restrained, Material-like, single-primary-colour look.

colors.categoricalNotes: No chart palette. For qualitative status colours beyond success/warning/danger: choose from PrimeNG palettes, limit the number of colours, prefer lighter shades to reduce noise. Tag colour pairs (background/text): #B3E5FC/#23547B, #FFD8B2/#805B36, #C8E6C9/#256029, #FEEDAF/#8A5340, #FFCDD2/#C63737, #ECCFFF/#694382 – one colour per unique value; custom tags use the same hue for background and text.
colors.notes: Mayo Blue #0057B8 for the top bar (white shield logo, app name white bold H3). Primary #2196F3, primary-lightest/highlight #E3F2FD, error #B00020. Blue palette 50–900 listed in 'sequential' (Ultima). Surfaces: ground #FAFAFA, section/card/overlay #FFFFFF, border rgba(0,0,0,.12), hover rgba(0,0,0,.04); state tints primary at 4% (subtle areas) and 16% (focus). Status: success #689F38 (text #1B5E20 on #C8E6C9), warning #FBC02D (text #7f6003 on #FFECB3), danger #D32F2F (text #B71C1C on #FFCDD2). Icons use secondary text colour. Badges only red or blue (mostly blue). 'gridline' above is the surface-border token, not a chart spec.

typography.fallback: Helvetica Neue Light, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, Lucida Grande, sans-serif
typography.notes: 1rem = Roboto 14pt in Ultima. PrimeFlex scale: text-xs .75rem, sm .875, base 1, lg 1.125, xl 1.25, 2xl 1.5, 3xl 1.75, 4xl 2, 5xl 2.5, 6xl 3, 7xl 4, 8xl 6rem. Weights mostly 400/500/600. Dialog title text-xl 500; card title text-xl 600; alt card title text-2xl 700; table column label base 500; cell/paragraph base 400. Avoid line-height-1. Labels lighter weight/shade, values heavier.

structure.frame: Content sits in white cards (shadow-1 elevation) on #FAFAFA ground; overlays use shadow-8.

labels.numberFormat: Badges: round or use scientific notation rather than overflow.

furniture.title: Block titles left-aligned, h4 bold 700, line-height 1.5, with an optional filter dropdown on the right.
furniture.logo: White-only Mayo shield logo in the Mayo-blue top bar only.
furniture.other: Tables: 36px title/label line, 36px row height (Small Table default), 36px footer with row count; settings button appears only on row hover.

layout: PrimeFlex 12-column grid; spacing in 0.25rem increments; tighter spacing for related items; dialog paddings 32/21/14px; full-screen dialog 1024px wide; slim side nav to save space for dense data.
interaction: Tooltips preferred over help text; default positions (buttons: right; tabs: top; inputs: bottom). Row hover turns grey (surface-hover rgba(0,0,0,.04)); focus uses primary at 16%. Keep PrimeNG standard states.
accessibility: Consider colour blindness and contrast; don't rely on grey tags to mean 'unimportant'.

chartTypes.notes: No chart guidance in the document.

distinctiveRules.rule: Use a single primary colour (#2196F3) and its tints; avoid other palettes ('Minimal Palette').
distinctiveRules.quote: Refrain from using palettes other than the primary palette.

distinctiveRules.rule: All app text in Roboto; primary text rgba(0,0,0,.87), secondary/icons rgba(0,0,0,.6).
distinctiveRules.quote: The primary font family in the Ultima theme is Roboto.

distinctiveRules.rule: Top bar always Mayo Blue #0057B8 with white-only shield logo and bold white app name.
distinctiveRules.quote: recommending that all applications use the “Mayo blue” color (#0057B8) for the top bar

distinctiveRules.rule: White cards (#FFFFFF) on #FAFAFA ground, borders rgba(0,0,0,.12), hover rgba(0,0,0,.04).
Status colours: success #689F38, warning #FBC02D (also 'medium'), danger #D32F2F, each with light-background/dark-text message variants.
distinctiveRules.quote: There are 3 general statuses: Success, Warning and Danger

distinctiveRules.rule: Categorical tags: square-cornered (no pills), text only, fixed pastel-background/dark-text pairs, one colour per value.
distinctiveRules.quote: We do NOT recommend usage of tag types ‘Pills’ and ‘Icons.’ The addition of rounded edges and imagery adds visual noise.

distinctiveRules.rule: Prefer lighter shades and plain text to reduce visual noise; only primary actions, errors and navigation targets should stand out.
distinctiveRules.quote: When everything stands out, nothing stands out.

distinctiveRules.rule: Dense layout: 36px rows/headers/footers, small components by default, avoid large buttons.
distinctiveRules.quote: use the ‘Small Table’ size as the default size for most tables. In this option, the line heights of rows are 36px.

distinctiveRules.rule: Labels in lighter weight/shade, values in heavier weight/shade.
distinctiveRules.quote: choose lighter weights and shades for labels and heavier weights/shades for associated values

referenceImages.describes: Application top bar (not a chart): full-width Mayo blue (#0057B8) bar with a circular lighter-blue expand button at far left, white outline Mayo shield logo with 'Mayo Clinic Laboratories' in small white two-line text, a slightly darker separator, app name 'WorkBench' in bold white Roboto, and white outline search/bell icons plus avatar at the right.

PrimeFlex type-scale table (not a chart): class names text-xs … text-8xl in bold blue on the left, grey Roboto sample text 'Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet' growing from .75rem to 6rem, rem values in blue at right, thin light-grey row dividers.
